mechanism: Both drugs can cause photosensitivity and gastrointestinal irritation; minocycline may inhibit CYP3A4 slightly affecting celecoxib metabolism, and combined NSAID with tetracycline increases GI ulceration risk.
action: Monitor for GI symptoms and photosensitivity; counsel on sun protection and take celecoxib with food; consider alternative antibiotics if GI intolerance develops.
